products.title: Jefftron V3 Mosfet
products.body_html:
This Jefftron V3 mosfet is designed to increase gun rate of fire, and battery will hold longer compared to basic wiring. It is fully integrated inside the gearbox version 3 instead of the original trigger contacts, and is compatible with Tokyo Marui standard.

Why Do I Need A Mosfet? | What Do They Do?

SPECIFICATIONS 

- Mosfet build on trigger contacts from SHS company
- Easy installation inside the gearbox version 3
- Presoldered wires allows faster and easier installation into the gun, it is long enough for all kind of weapons. Simply cut wires to the required length and attach connectors (included in package)
- On the devices are presoldered high quality 2 black wires 1,5 qmm (AWG16) with MPPE insulation, length 400 mm to the motor and 600 mm to the battery. The blue wire 0.34 qmm (AWG22) with a length 1000 mm is used for connection anywhere on the red cable
- In package is included 1000 mm red wire 1,5qmm (AWG16) with MPPE insulation
- Board covered by conformal coating, it protect device against water
- If you want to use your own wires, choose device without wiring
- Designed for spring up to M160 (equivalent for current 75A single shot fire or 25A burst fire for max. 30s). For higher load please use Mosfet II (it is outside gearbox)
- Specified for common batteries up to 17V (Ni-xx 8.4 - 12V, lipol 7.4 - 14.8V)
- No current consumption in the idle mode
- No sparking on switch contacts
- In auto fire mode piston stops in random position due the mechabox design
- For right function is necessary to have a functional gearbox cut off lever, selector plate, reverse latch, trigger and trigger block, as it has the standard gearbox

DEVICE INSTRUCTIONS

You can download installation manual in English here 

PACKING

- Mosfet on trigger contacts with wiring
- Trigger switch
- DeanT connector male
- 30A Mini fuse
- 4x Faston female 2,8mm
- 6x Black heat shrink tube 3,2mm - length 20mm
- 3x Black heat shrink tube 4,8mm - length 20mm
- Installation manual in English

products.title: STSS Inner Barrel Precision Hop-Up
products.body_html:
Looking for an affordable inner barrel hop up system? Then look no further. The STSS 3D printed hop-up is an affordable and precision made hop-up to give you a solid accuracy.

What Is and How Does a Hop Up Work?

Features:
  1. Used for Low-Mid Power Blasters - Adjustable topspin
  2. Simple but effective
  3. It comes with the mounting grub screw and adjustment grub screw as well as the required hex key.
  4. Increase distance and accuracy A LOT!
  5. Forces the balls to backspin. Also can control left a right swing by rotating it.
  6. Eliminates gel ball arc.
  7. Will work best with the barrel upgrade.
How to install:

  1. The mouth of the acr muzzle is threaded, and the thread of hup up that is screwed up can be screwed directly.

  2. The ‘O’ Ring sent between the hop up and the ACR gun muzzle, which is stable.

products.title: Universal APACHE Tappetless Cylinder Head/ Nozzle
products.body_html:
How does a perfect seal and no tappet plate or return spring sound?

Well to Aztech Innovations it sounded pretty damn amazing.

Here it is, the APACHE!  The first of its kind in the world, all air controlled driven by the piston. 

-No mechanical forks or prongs to retract the nozzles
-No timing issues
-No broken return springs 
-No broken tappet plates and best of all no fps droop on high rate of fire.

The all in one sealed cylinder head ensures perfect seal for max air flow and zero air loss with out any mechanical gear driven parts to create issues.

The APACHE produces extremely consistent high pressure air flow seen as a huge improvement in consistency of feet per second plus a noticeable improvement in accuracy thanks to reduced turbulence of the airflow through the tri port and past the aerodynamic "boat tail'' internal nozzle, combined these streamline the airflow into the barrel and behind the gel, pushing the gel in a single uniform flow for max power.

Please note, using an APACHE DOES NOT increase the volume of your cylinder.  The APACHE doesn't open be able to increase volume, it opens when cylinder pressure increases through the piston moving forward, then the air moves from the Cylinder forward into the APACHE, the volume doesn't increase as it opens it moves.

Compatability

- Universal on all Gel Blasters

products.title: Aluminium HPA Multi-Fit Electric Pistol Adaptor Kit
products.body_html:
Welcome to the all new Multi-Fit Pistol Adaptor. This adaptor is truly unique with some of the most dynamic features ever seen in the industry for this particular product.


This product is cross-platform, which means it comes with 3 attachments to make it compatible with either your Hi-Capa (2011), 1911 & G-Series style pistols.


Sporting 3 interchangeable attachments to allow you to choose which pistol you would like to use by simply installing that specific attachment and you're good to go with your pistol of choice!


This adaptor allows you to connect your pistol to an air tank and use an M4 magazine as your ammo, essentially giving you 200+ shots at a time instead of using the 20 which fits into a normal gas magazine.


This adaptor also comes with a sound-activated mosfet which will prime your electric magazines to allow perfect feeding with every shot.


Important Info - This product will come as a DIY kit due to the nature of the multi-fit attachments. You will need to assemble it yourselves. We will have an installation walkthrough video available before the product lands.


Each magazine will have its own inner mag sleeve for the single stacking of the gels which have been designed perfectly and will be flawless.


*Note* M92 Beretta attachment is still in production and will be released at a later date.

Gas Mag Compatibility
  • Golden Eagle 1911/ Hi-Capa (Single & Double Stack)
  • WELLS MP5k
  • Double Bell Hi-Capa & G-Series
  • (Other brands will fit, you will have to make a custom sleeve to match your mag of choice for the single stack feeding)
In The Package
  • 5 x Attachments for the following pistols (Hi-Capa, 1911, G-Series, Beretta & MP5k)
  • 1 x 7.4v HPA Battery 
  • 1 x USB Charger
  • 2 x Different IGL Styles (Straight & 45 Degree)
  • 1 x Feed Tube

products.title: DNA MCU - V2 Mosfet (Wolverine HPA Engine)
products.body_html:
The “DNA MCU” (Magazine Control Unit) by Double Dippa Designs, is designed for use with all variants of the Wolverine Inferno HPA Engines FCU’s.

The “DNA MCU” fixes the issue of having constant power going to the magazine, and makes it so the magazine only receives power when the trigger is pulled.
By using the included ‘Y’ connector, both the FCU and MCU can be powered by a single 2S (7.4V) battery. And for high R.O.F. builds 2 batteries can be used, a 2S (7.4V) to power the Wolverine Inferno FCU and a 3S or 4S (11.1V or 14.8V) to power the MCU which in turn will give the magazine either 11.1V or 14.8V making it feed faster.

products.title: Tactical Solar Power System Trijicon SRS Red Dot Sight
products.body_html:
This tactical Trijicon SRS red dot sight represents the highest level of performance from a sealed reflex-style sight. Because of its innovative design, the SRS takes up less rail space while maintaining the durability expected from Trijicon. The shorter housing eliminates the tube-effect typical of other sealed reflex sights. Featuring a large 38mm aperture, the Trijicon SRS provides a massive field of view for quicker target engagements. The 1.75 MOA dot is small enough for precision and with 10 brightness settings it can be bright enough for any speed. Finally, the Trijicon SRS features dual power sources — an innovative solar cell assisted by a single AA battery.

  • Day/Night Reticle Colour: Red
  • Adjustment @ 100 yards (clicks/in): 1/2 click per in.
  • Mount Comes With: Quick Release Mount
  • Housing Material: High Grade Aluminum Alloy
  • "+" button: Power ON and brightness adjustment
  • "-" button: Power ON and brightness adjustment
  • "+" and "-" buttons: Power OFF, depressing both keys simultaneously
  • Manually Adjustable Brightness Controls: 10 Brightness settings, Including 3 night vision and one super bright
  • Large Viewing Area Allows for Rapid Target Aquisition

products.title: GBU Hi-Capa Pistol Pro Stainless Steel Competition Barrel
products.body_html:
﻿Finally, the best performance stainless steel pistol barrels are here. We have locally manufactured these, sparring no cost at all. Perfectly sized with 7.35 mm inner diameter with a seam running along the inside of the barrel to increase accuracy. These barrels are the most effective Hi-Capa barrels in Australia !

How To Install

How to Install your Pro Stainless Steel Pistol Barrel

Performance and Features

The weight of the Stainless removes all vibrations throughout the barrel whilst shooting to improve accuracy and consistency in your FPS (Feet Per Second). Our GBU Pro barrels are designed to increase your Feet Per Second by at least 15% which makes this the easiest and most effective upgrade to your blaster, without going into the gearbox.

Another feature we have finalised through testing is the seam inside the barrel, if you look down it you will see a seam running directly from top to bottom of the barrel. When installing this barrel, to increase accuracy make sure the seam is at the top as it adds accuracy to your shots.

We are confident these are what you are looking for, if you are looking for the best.

Specifications

- Inner Diameter  7.5mm
- Outer Diameter 9.5mm
- Stainless Steel 
- Up To 15% FPS Increase 
- Seam inside barrel, point to top for increased accuracy

Necessary Modifications 

Due to the nature of a universal barrel there is some very minor modifications to suite both WEtech, AW and GE platforms.

For the GE model pistols you will need to open the barrel housing and on the inside you will the a tab on each side of the housing where the pistol sits. You will need to grind out both tabs in order for the barrel to sit flush inside the housing. For further information please contact us.

For the WE model pistols the rubber bucking will seem loose when put over the barrel, so in this case you will need to put some electrical tape around the rear end of the barrel, just enough for the rubber bucking to be tight enough to sit on the barrel. For further information please contact us.

products.title: GBU Custom Series CNC 4.3 Hi-Capa Outer Barrel
products.body_html:
GBU yet again brings you the highest quality 5.1 Hi-Capa outer barrel on the market. Made from 7075 Aluminium, sporting 2 different colour designs and perfect machining. 

With an inner Diameter of 9.5mm at the end with a 14mm thread, these outer barrels have been designed for alloy barrels, if installing with a stock pistol with a plastic barrel you may need to dremmel out the front section 1-2mm so the barrel feeds straight through.

These outer barrels have been designed in Australia and have been created for the most distinctive looks and set at the highest quality at the best prices in Australia.

Material

- 7075 Alluminium, CNC Machined

Compatability

- Golden Eagle Hi-Capa Range
- WE-Tech
- Double Bell Hi-Capa Range
- John Wick TTI Hi-Capa
- JG Works Hi-Capa
- AW Custom 
- Tactical Tomato 

Specifications

- 14mm Threaded End

products.title: SHS Gear Sets
products.body_html:
Genuine SHS carbon steel gear set. High grade steel and the perfect upgrade for your internal gearbox.

If you have kept an eye out over the past 2 years, there has been so many different SHS gear types. To ensure you are getting genuine gears, look under the SECTOR GEAR, the round holes should be CNC and taper in, as fake gear sets will have a flat base underneath and of course the most obvious key is that they will not last you more than a game or so.

Cast Metal vs. SHS Metal Gears
